plainText:
Erica Mendez is an American actor and voice director for the English-language dub of and .

==Biography==
Mendez was born on February 13, 1988, and she became a voice actress as an adult. Mendez first worked on Pokémon by voicing characters in Pokémon Masters EX and Pokémon: Twilight Wings before joining the during , voicing recurring character Parker. She would later voice Mollie of the Rising Volt Tacklers in Pokémon Horizons: The Series, with her also starting to do voice direction for several episodes of the English dub during its third season.
